title: TC-TIB-027 — [Happy path] Reorder inline items (drag-drop + Sort A→Z) persists
steps:
Preconditions: Global Option (Additional Option, source = Create new) with 3+ items, not alphabetically ordered

  1. Drag-and-drop reorder the items into a new order
  2. Save, reload the editor
  3. Separately, trigger the Sort A→Z action
  4. Save, reload
expectedResult: The drag-drop order persists after save/reload, including on the storefront. Sort A→Z reorders items alphabetically by name and that order also persists.
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com / linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com. GO 986 on campaign 2730 / layer-226664. Items before test: Blue, Green, XSS-payload, Zebra, Apple (not alphabetical).

Observed (direct) — drag-drop: Performed a real mouse drag (mousedown on the "Apple" row's thumbnail area, moved in multiple steps, mouseup over the "Blue" row) using Playwright's low-level mouse API to simulate an actual pointer drag (the list uses a custom data-draggable sortable, not native HTML5 DnD). Order changed live to [Apple, Blue, Green, XSS-item, Zebra]. Saved, then reloaded the Edit page from a fresh navigation — order persisted exactly: [Apple, Blue, Green, XSS-item, Zebra].

Observed (direct) — Sort A→Z: Clicked the sort icon next to the "Additional Options" heading. Order changed to [XSS-item, Apple, Blue, Green, Zebra] — alphabetically correct for the real names (Apple, Blue, Green, Zebra); the XSS-payload item's literal name starts with "<" which sorts before "A" in standard string comparison, so its position is consistent with a true string-based A→Z sort, not a bug. Saved, reloaded fresh — order persisted identically.

Observed (direct) — storefront: Pushed campaign Update, waited for propagation, loaded storefront with app-v1.js cache bypass + localStorage customization-memory cleared (see TC-015 note on this). The field's item label order was ["", "Apple", "Blue - en", "Green - en", "Zebra"] (empty string = the XSS item's sanitized/escaped display) — matches the Sort A→Z order from the portal exactly.

Conclusion (direct observation): Both drag-drop reorder and Sort A→Z persist correctly after save/reload and propagate correctly to the storefront.
